stories.title: 固化 pool500 read-only shadow evidence 治理边界
acceptanceCriteria: pool500 route is read-only shadow evidence and is not a new candidate generation path
pool500 contract requires no candidate generation and no current_ranking_route replacement
FULL_POOL500_READY is recall artifact readiness only and does not authorize ranking promotion or ranking input replacement
current_ranking_route remains the existing pool200/top_k=5 ranking gate and must not be weakened by pool500 evidence
internal evidence may keep trace_ref, agent_runtime_trace, diagnostics_path, raw_export_trace_path, ranking_evidence_path for debugging
public display is allowlist-first and must reject trace_ref, agent_runtime_trace, diagnostics_path, raw_export_trace_path, ranking_evidence_path
PRD JSON checks are covered by tests/test_engineering_contracts.py and scripts/ci/validate_engineering_contracts.py

stories.title: 分离内部证据与公开展示 schema
acceptanceCriteria: producer may emit internal evidence for pool500 shadow diagnostics without exposing it to public display
display adapter exports only allowlisted timeline fields for Agent/frontend consumption
tests reject public display payloads containing trace_ref, agent_runtime_trace, diagnostics_path, raw_export_trace_path, ranking_evidence_path
